findings.evidence: ALTER TABLE products DROP COLUMN description
findings.explanation: Dropping column 'description' from table 'products' immediately destroys column data and breaks backward compatibility for active application code in rolling deployments that continues to read or write this column.
findings.recommendation: Adopt expand-contract migration pattern: (1) Deprecate and remove column references from application code; (2) Deploy application release N; (3) Drop column in subsequent release N+1 after verifying no active queries access it.
findings.statement: ALTER TABLE products DROP COLUMN description;
